display.purpose: A screen’s own title, once per screen, at 30/500 with -1.05px tracking.

title.purpose: Section heads, feature-card titles, sheet titles; 22/500. The Coaching lead is this style at 24px.

heading.purpose: Head of an empty state or grouped list; 17/600.

body.purpose: Reading text, bubbles, posts; 15/400 at 21px line height. Row names are body at 500/16.

body-strong.purpose: Pill labels, prices (tabular), anything found while scrolling.

small.purpose: Subtitles, previews, card bodies at 19px line height.

small-strong.purpose: Chip labels, links inside cards, timestamps that matter.

caption.purpose: Stamps and tile labels; the only tracked-out style. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: The primary pill. The one shadow on the page, in the brand colour so it recolours by palette.

shadows.name: lift-small
shadows.purpose: Round brand buttons: create, ask arrow, send.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Long-press menus, sheets, toasts, the upload bar. Overlays, not page elements.

motion.name: ease-draw
motion.purpose: MarkDraw: court 640ms, net +360ms/420ms, post +540ms/420ms. Already drawn under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: live-dot
motion.purpose: LiveDot ring: scale 1 to 2.8, opacity 0.55 to 0. Still under Reduce Motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Tappable press feedback on pills and round buttons.

motion.name: bar-duck
motion.purpose: The create button shrinks as the tab bar ducks on scroll down.

wash.fade: linear to {bg} from 35% to 100% of height
wash.rule: Behind a screen’s opening moment or inside a card; never under a scrolling list.

extensions.origin: public/waitlist.html — the app shares the waitlist page’s type, ground, washes, pills and dotted rules.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action on a card or screen; the only page element that casts a shadow, in its own colour.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.15px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 60ms ease,opacity 120ms ease;background:#3F7049;color:#FAF8F0;box-shadow:0 6px 12px rgba(63,112,73,0.28);}.ds-btn-primary:hover{transform:scale(1.04);}.ds-btn-primary:active{transform:scale(0.97);}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3F7049;outline-offset:3px;}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:0.5;cursor:default;}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A second action beside the primary; strong-tan hairline, no shadow.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.15px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 60ms ease,opacity 120ms ease;background:#E9E6DA;color:#24251F;border-color:#B8AF9D;}.ds-btn-secondary:hover{transform:scale(1.04);}.ds-btn-secondary:active{transform:scale(0.97);}.ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3F7049;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Holds the pill silhouette with no fill; the quiet third choice.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.15px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 60ms ease,opacity 120ms ease;background:transparent;color:#5D584C;}.ds-btn-ghost:hover{color:#24251F;}.ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3F7049;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive actions are outlined in danger red, never filled.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:14px 24px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid transparent;font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-0.15px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform 60ms ease,opacity 120ms ease;background:transparent;color:#A34D40;border-color:#A34D40;}.ds-btn-danger:hover{background:rgba(163,77,64,0.06);}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #A34D40;outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Chip
components.description: Filter and topic chips; selected fills with brand (or a passed tint) and drops its border.
components.css: .ds-chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;padding:7px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid #DCD6C8;background:#E9E6DA;color:#5D584C;font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, 'SF Pro Text', Roboto, sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;margin-right:8px;cursor:pointer;}.ds-chip:hover{border-color:#B8AF9D;}.ds-chip-on{background:#3F7049;color:#FAF8F0;border-color:transparent;}.ds-chip:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #3F7049;outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Pill Field
components.description: A question you could start typing: the Coaching ask field and the inbox search. Fully round, with a round brand arrow that carries the small lift.

narrative.overview: The app is the second surface of a world that began on the public waitlist page. It shares the page’s face (Inter, bundled), its cream ground, its clay-and-grass wash, its pills, its dotted rules and its card, so a screen reads like a page from the same magazine as the site people joined on rather than the category’s chrome. The material of the earlier world stayed: six palettes recoloured by slot, the 4px spacing ladder, the radius ladder, hairline tan borders, initials avatars and court placeholders, pill actions. The voice on top changed: display and title at 500 with tight tracking, dotted section breaks, colour as a wash rather than a fill, one shadow on the page in the brand’s own colour, and a mark that draws itself once on success and end cards.
keyCharacteristics: Inter at 400/500/600; display and title at medium weight with tight tracking; no black weights
Warm paper neutrals; never pure white or pure black in the default palette
Hairlines separate; boxes only for things that are genuinely a card
One shadow on the page, in the brand colour, under the primary action only
The wash at a screen’s opening moment or inside a card, never under a list
Six complete palettes, one authored source, no literal hex in a component

rules.name: The Every-Slot Rule
rules.body: Every palette defines every colour key and no component writes a literal hex; styles are recoloured by slot at draw time.

rules.name: The Wash Rule
rules.body: Colour at scale arrives as a feathered wash behind a screen’s opening moment or inside a card, never as a filled band and never under a scrolling list.

rules.name: The Surface Vocabulary Rule
rules.body: Clay, hard, grass and court classify; they never fill an action.

rules.name: The Medium Top Rule
rules.body: Nothing above 17px is set heavier than 500.

rules.name: The Tight Top Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows and opens only at caption size.

rules.name: The No-Kicker Rule
rules.body: No all-caps eyebrow above a heading; uppercase caption survives only as a stamp inside content or a tile label.

rules.name: The Rows-Not-Boxes Rule
rules.body: A list item is a row on a hairline, never a bordered card.

rules.name: The One Column Rule
rules.body: Past the column cap, extra width stays empty or becomes the rail.

rules.name: The One Shadow Rule
rules.body: On the page only the primary action casts a shadow, in its own colour; everything else gets a hairline.

rules.name: The Pill Rule
rules.body: Actions and action-like fields are pills; containers are rounded rectangles.

rules.name: The Dotted Break Rule
rules.body: A break between sections is a dotted rule, never a solid one or a band of surface.

dos: Do set weight through font('500') and the typography scale; never a bare fontWeight.
Do open a screen with its display title and one muted line, with the wash behind it only if it is that screen’s opening moment.
Do build lists as rows on hairlines with the line starting at the words.
Do keep the lift shadow to the primary action and round brand buttons, in the brand colour.
Do use the feature card (tile, title, body, one pill, one link, wash inside) for success and end moments.
Do take every colour from the theme so all six palettes keep working.
Do give every animated flourish a Reduce Motion path that lands on the finished state.
donts: Don’t set a title at 700 or 800, or use a display size above 30px on a screen title.
Don’t put an all-caps kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
Don’t put the wash under a scrolling list, or on every screen by default.
Don’t add a neutral or black shadow to anything that sits on the page.
Don’t stack bordered cards as page structure.
Don’t write a literal hex in a component outside a black-on-media surface.
Don’t use a court surface colour as an action colour.
Don’t ship imagery or an icon font; the mark is drawn, icons are vector, avatars are initials.
